allowed: archive byte identity and member metadata
exactly the first physical record of text-like data members
forbidden: geometry columns from the same physical rows as response values

published_endpoint_evidence.endpoint_definition: survey-recorded colonization of host trees previously recorded unoccupied
sources: Roberge et al. 2011 Journal of Applied Ecology
Singer et al. 2019 Methods in Ecology and Evolution

process_boundary.reason: published studies model colonization among mapped host trees using occupied-tree connectivity and tree-to-tree distances; exact source/update semantics would have required a response-free geometry registry

geometry_role_adjudication.triggered_stop_rule: tree geometry is available only in response-bearing physical rows
geometry_role_adjudication.reason: The public archive contains a single data member. Its permitted first physical record places x/y geometry columns in the same physical CSV rows as longitudinal abundance/occurrence response columns. Building the tree-node geometry would therefore require opening response-bearing rows, which is forbidden by the predeclared firewall.
geometry_role_adjudication.decision: Do not open row-level Neckera.csv. Do not freeze worlds, run the scale ladder, tune comparators, or perform held-out outcome evaluation for this candidate.
geometry_role_adjudication.scientific_interpretation: negative Gate 0 result demonstrating that the response firewall rejects an otherwise prospectively estimable candidate when predictor geometry cannot be frozen independently of outcomes

gate0_pass_if: stable public archive bytes are reproducibly obtainable
a complete tree-node registry and deterministic geometry/distance representation can be identified without opening response rows
gate0_stop_if: tree geometry is available only in response-bearing physical rows
endpoint-matched aggregate estimability becomes uncertain or ineligible
no_rescue: Do not extract response-bearing coordinate rows, change event minima, redefine the endpoint, or weaken the response firewall after Gate 0.
